STRIPE_LIST_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS.description: List balance transactions (the money moving in and out of your Stripe balance), newest first. Filter by created (gt, gte, lt, lte, Unix seconds), currency, payout, source, type; page with limit (1-100) and starting_after or ending_before.

created.description: Only transactions created in this range, Unix seconds: gt, gte, lt, lte.

starting_after.description: A transaction id: the page after it.
